bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 4, 6, 7, 8. A LITTLE BIT DUSTY was dominant from in front when he trialed here with Mitchell Bell aboard and he will be ready to fire when he now makes his race-day debut today. DEBRIEFING is trained here and after leading throughout in her recent lead-up trial here at her home base, she's now more than ready to make her debut. OUR ASTUTE LASS was spelled after there were excuses for her unplaced effort on debut at Armidale. She trialed here recently with Izzy Neale aboard and she can return as an improved filly with Izzy retaining the ride today. PEREGRINA PEARL must be forgiven for her unplaced debut effort at Eagle Farm when post race issues were detected. She's since been given a stable change, she trialed here recently with Rory Hutchings aboard and she's another who should return improved today.

raceTips.comment: A Little Bit Dusty won a recent trial by a space and strikes a very winnable maiden to debut in. Mitchell Bell rode in said trial and sticks on here as an added bonus. Peregrina Pearl bled on debut incurring the standard three month ban. Now with a new stable, a recent trial was promising. Debriefing is another debutant coming off a trial win and looks to have ability. Our Astute Lass was kept safe in betting on debut last prep and did enough. Given time, her trial was sound.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 3, 6, 7. VITAVA begins his second campaign for the Wilkes stable today. He did all but win here at home over this distance when he resumed from his last spell and this race is within his reach first up, aided by the claim for Gabrielle Johnston. AFRICAN DIAMOND resumes at her home base with all involved hoping that history repeats. She was dominant when she tackled this trip here at home first up last campaign. GELSEY didn't threaten second up at Gunnedah but she did beat home two next start winners and she is more suitably placed in this class when she returns to her home base today. ENSIGN PARKER and ENDLESS APPLAUSE are others who are worthy of consideration.

raceTips.comment: Vltava resumes without a trial to reference but did everything but win when resuming at track/trip last prep. Form thereafter over further reads well relative to this and expecting his class to carry him. African Diamond has trialled well and comes to hand quickly. The race shape looks ideal for her. The best efforts of Gelsey are above this class. Ensign Parker should get a soft run with best efforts being good enough though last start was average.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 6, 7, 8, 11. THE PROSPECT shouldn't be harshly judged for his unplaced Newcastle effort last start on the Beaumont track when his race was not run to suit him. He will appreciate this switch to the country circuit when he now makes a Muswellbrook debut with a gear change made (blinkers on). LINDA'S PRINCESS finished unplaced last start at Newcastle on the course proper when her performance was better than it appears at face value. She returns to her home base, more suitably placed this afternoon. BURNING LOVE will take on older opposition when she makes her race-day debut today. However, after trialing twice last month, she can be expected to cope over this testing distance at her first run in a race. ROYAL AND READY had too much to do before he finished unplaced last start at Wyong. His unplaced effort on the day must be overlooked.

raceTips.comment: Linda's Princess has been beaten less than a length in her past two starts so seemingly has her hoof firmly on the till. She is a backmarker so always needs luck in running, but strikes a very suitable race to finally break through. Redaluca Girl has had her fair share of chances but best efforts would be up to a race of this calibre. The Prospect was disappointing last time but the addition of blinkers can spark improvement. Burning Love has been sound at the trials and kept safe in betting which should be respected.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 6, 9, 10. GEMTIKI can be given the chance to atone for her costly last start defeat at Taree when she tackles a distance rise today. She has been produced here over this distance once and she did score with authority on that day. BACKHANDER presents fourth up and she's been given a foundation which can allow her to relish an awaiting distance rise today. DAMASCUS GATE has been in work for some time however, aided by the claim for Jordie Thompson, he can maintain his consistency when he returns to his home base today. SAMOAN ROMAN is yet to open his account but he's only been produced twice and last start at Bathurst, he did indicate that this journey will now suit when he will be making his home track debut.

raceTips.comment: Gemtiki was strong to and through the line when finding one better last time out when well supported and strikes a perfect race to get back into the winners circle. Samoan Roman sparks interest with forward placement here. Still a maiden but will be winning soon enough and the distance rise looks highly ideal. Damascus Gate is always an on pace hope in these races and offsets weight with a claimer on. Backhander next best.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 3, 4, 9, 10, 15. AMAJICSTAR found the line with no dangers after leading when she was produced on debut last start at Newcastle with Liberty Smyth aboard. She can already take the next step here at her home base today, with Liberty retaining the ride. MR CORNSTAR was kept fresh before he led throughout here last start. He should have more to offer when he presents fresh again today over this same distance and after a subsequent trial at Gosford. FROSTISEN begins her second campaign today after trialing twice last month at Gosford. She concedes weight to all however, she can be expected to rise to the occasion. CITY GOLD SPEED didn't finish far from the winner when he was produced after a twenty-two day break at Taree. A quicker back-up can be regarded as a plus today.

raceTips.comment: Frostisen has been trialling well in strong heats leading into this preparation after having shown ability in her initial campaign. She appeals at the price. Amajicstar was impressive winning on debut and has a stack of upside so not surprisingly the market has gravitated her way. Bonoyster was a consistent minor money placegetter prior to a spell and can follow that trend here at very least. City Gold Speed hasn't won for a while but best efforts would be good enough.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 4, 6, 7, 13. MAYSUN should not be harshly judged for her first up defeat on a heavy track at Bathurst. She will be more suitably placed today with gear changes made. (Blinkers now replace winkers). FORCE MARCH was resuming on the Beaumont track at home (Newcastle) last start when he was too good for all except the winner. He can only now present race-fitter. RED PLANET BAR was spelled after his solid debut effort at Newcastle. He begins his second campaign today after trialing twice last month and he can return to the races as an improved three-year-old this afternoon. CREDIBILITY was honest second up when he stepped up into this distance range last start on the Beaumont track at his Newcastle home base. He will have scope to improve when he now makes a Muswellbrook debut.

raceTips.comment: Bascilica Babe had excuses last start so be forgiving of the beaten margin. She is hard-fit at this point of the prep and seemingly screaming out for a distance rise like this. Just needs to lob in a good spot from a tricky draw. Force March ran on strongly into second when resuming and is deserving of favouritism on that effort. Maysun strips fitter second up and looks helped with the addition of blinkers. Magatama next best.
